Let me tell you guys a little bit about Mosul.

In my last post on reddit, I discussed the ordeal it was to get to and from mid-tour leave. Well, as soon as I got back from mid-tour leave, our company was packing up to leave back to Kuwait. Shit, they already moved all our stuff into a consolidated area because our replacements were taking over the FOB. My gunner packed up my shit for me, and I know he found my weed, but he never mentioned it, he just put the baggy nicely away amongst the rest of my stuff. Less than a week after I was back in Iraq, there was a major suicide bombing. We didn't have news, and internet was spotty as fuck, you might be able to get out a few e-mails before it shut out, and actually browsing websites was out of the question when it took yahoo mail like 5 minutes to load and we had 10 minute time limits. News about this chow hall bombing was just the official word from our officers.

A day after the bombing, we get word that we have to go up to Mosul in support of the elections up there. These were going to be the first free elections in Iraq since the US invaded. We were on the tail end of our deployment, only had a month left in country, and the whole battalion was packing up to leave.... It was just our company too, the rest of the battalion was finished with their mission.

Fuck. Fuck fuck fuck fuck fuck.

We didn't have a quiet deployment, we had been through some shit and a lot of nonsense, but up in Mosul, things were popping off, and that is not where any of us wanted to be, especially this close to redeployment back to Germany.

We had to ride in the Bradleys on HETs all the way up there. I remember getting there, late afternoon/early night. It was dark as fuck. Whatever FOB we were on was just so fucking noisy. We're done unloading the vehicles, and I'm starving, so I tell my Bradley Commander that I'm going to go find the chow hall, I'll come back and get everyone once I find it.

FOB Marez, look that one up. I found myself back at this particular FOB in 2009, but it was completely different then. In 2004, it was dimly lit, no concrete barriers up everywhere, just wide open, and huge as fuck. This FOB is probably about 3 miles from end to end. I searched every fucking corner of this FOB looking for the damn chow hall, and I could not find that bitch. Finally, I stepped into an AT&T calling center

[Side note] Fuck AT&T for ripping off soldiers overseas in a combat zone. Fuck those mother fuckers with a rusty fucking shovel. Whoever in the military command authorized AT&T to put rip off calling centers on FOBs in Iraq should be lined up against the wall and shot. [end sidenote]

I stepped into an AT&T calling center and said, "Sorry for disturbing you, but where the fuck is the chow hall around here?"

Everyone stopped talking on their phone calls, and just stared at me for about .5 seconds. I could feel them staring into my soul. Then some fellow, who was in the middle of a phone call says, in the most southern draw I could fathom and this look of sorrow in his eyes, "Aintcha hurd? It got blown up."

"Oh shit, that was here? My bad", as I snuck myself out of the AT&T calling trailer. Fuck me, now one told me we were going to the FOB that the chow hall was exploded.

I get back to where all the vehicles are staged, and my Bradley Commander asks if I found the chow hall, and I tell him this is the FOB where the chow hall got blown up 3 days earlier. Oops.

From FOB Marez, we are sent to where we'll be spending the next month. Some fucking shithole COP or COB, I forget what the fuck the called it, but it had no running water, the shit had to be burned, and meals were MREs. Baths were with these hospital "shower wipes". The season had shifted from motherfuckin hot and hot, to motherfucking cold and wet.

Each platoon in my company was attached to a company of 82nd. Our cycle was 3 days running missions out of the COB, and 1 day back at Marez to refuel and refit. We'd also be at the other platoons' COBs while they were sent to refit.

Our COB, I don't even remember the name of it, it was just a fucking mud pit. There was a building there where the company HQ was set up, and cots side by side. I slept in the vehicle rather than the cots because there just wasn't enough room to fit the whole platoon in the room they set aside for us. I remember they sent us out these premade bagels, already cut in half an a cream cheese disk in the middle. There was no way to warm them up, it was like trying to bite off a brick lol. It was shit.

We didn't shave while we were at the COB because it just wasn't possible. It was freezing cold. So one night, on our return to Marez, we stopped at this other FOB. We parked the bradleys and went looking for the chow hall, and found it. There was some SPC at the door who told us that we couldn't enter unshaven. One of our squad leaders just looked at him and gave out a "I'll kill you" chuckle as he walked by him, and we all just walked right in. This was before we turned all the palaces back over to the Iraqis. This place had marble floors, big ceilings, and was just amazing. There was a soft-serve ice cream machine. I heard Ode to Joy in my head as I walked in. There were like 4 different serving stations, each with different foods. I wanted to cry, that all this good food was available to us, and there were brothers, comrades, who's last meals were shitty MREs. You could get burgers and fries or pasta and pizza or asian or whatever the fuck you wanted. It was amazing. We all filled our plates as high as we could, burgers on top of pizza on top of whatever the fuck else.

All of our stomachs had shrunken so much from starving that it was like two slices of pizza, and we were full. We were all sitting there, plates towering with food, and none of us could even put a dent into it. That was the most depressing part of stopping there.

That was our environment in Mosul. Our platoon didn't see much action there. One of our guys got hit by a sniper in the back of the helmet, but that was about it. Most of the action there happened before and after we were there.

Anyways, this will be my last story that I'm posting to reddit. Nothing against you guys, but reddit as a whole has turned into such a disgusting place that I don't want to contribute my stories to this website.

This right here is my turning point. Seriously, not a single post about our fallen brothers was on the front page of reddit on Memorial Day besides this post. Oh, btw, that comment was removed. I don't care which way you lean politically, but the behavior enabled by the admin of this site is just disgusting. The admin will come out to talk shit about the President, but won't even come out to say thanks to those who we've lost?

I'm just sick of this shit. This website has become solely about pushing agenda. To the highest bidder.

I'll continue sharing my stories, but just not with reddit. You guys are cool, but this website fucking sucks.
